sentences.text: THE HONOURABLE DR. JUSTICE KAUSER EDAPPAGATH
Thursday, the 11th day of July 2024 / 20th Ashadha, 1946  WP(C) NO. 32540 OF 2022  PETITIONER:

VIJAYAKUMAR B., S/O BHASKARA MENON,GOURINANDANAM, PATTANAKKAD.P.O,
 ALAPPUZHA-688531.
 RESPONDENTS:
 1. NATIONAL HIGHWAY AUTHORITY OF INDIA, REPRESENTED BY DY GENERAL  MANAGER CUM PROJECT DIRECTOR, NO.36/414(III), NEAR NSS HIGHER  SECONDARY SCHOOL, PALKULANGARA, TRIVANDRUM-695024.
 AND 4 OTHERS  Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to pass an Interim Order, directing the respondents to disburse  the balance amount of Rs. 28,12,594/- along with solatium and interest, by  passing an Award, as determined in Exhibit P8, in respect to the  residential building, in Sy No. 44/3-4-1 of Pattanakkad Village and the  compensation for his loss of residence, under the 2nd Schedule of the  Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, pending final disposal of the  Writ Petition.

sentences.text:
This petition again coming on for orders upon perusing the petition  and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and this Court's order dated  21.06.2024 and upon hearing the arguments of SRI. S.KRISHNAMOORTHY, SNEHA  ROSE and P.S.ARUNA, Advocates for the petitioner, STANDING COUNSEL for R1  and of GOVERNMENT PLEADER for R2 to R5, the court passed the following:
 ORDER Post on 29.07.2024.
Interim order is extended till then.
